verdict.rationale: Authy has public developer documentation, including Twilio's Authy API and SDK docs, so publishing an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence mentions llms.txt, machine-readable docs, or documentation written for AI agents. The only docs evidence describes SDKs and the API's deprecation, which is not agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
